stage: S4 unrest suppressed (claims of displaced citizens defeated: repression, populist redirection, or neglect without adequate redistribution)

stage_probability.ci_type: structural range: min/max of P(US or China) across pre-registered structural variants (4000x8 runs); Monte Carlo CI is separate
stage_probability.definition: P(in at least one of US/China, within 20y of the S2 midpoint, EITHER the state represses (REPRESS or carrot-and-stick MIX) in >=3 of the last 4 mass-unrest years (>=1% participation) with no adequate redistribution in place (strict S4), OR at the horizon the regime is not overthrown and for >=3 consecutive years displacement >=20% of labor income has had no adequate redistribution (transfers >= 50% of lost labor income) | S1, S2, S3). Independence between US and China.

by_jurisdiction_headline.note: China's S4 is mostly pre-existing autocratic inertia (see counterfactual), not the scenario text's AI-rentier story. Pass S5/S6 the per-jurisdiction probabilities and the mechanism increment, not only the combined number.

timeline.definition: Calendar year of the first S4 among US/China (strict lock-in year, or first year claims had been unmet >=3 consecutive years, provisional), conditional on S4. T2 aligned to the S2 model's S2a onset distribution.
timeline.integrator_note: Re-time with the S2 model's own onset draws using the exported offsets if the S2 distribution changes.

counterfactual_note: Counterfactual sets coercion automation a=0 and AI revenue share at today's level (dependence on labor stays full); common random numbers with the main run.

quantities_for_other_stages.note_for_S5_S6: Broad S4 includes populist redirection and neglect, not only violent repression. Only strict S4 implies the state has actively crushed unrest. China's number is party-state repression, not AI-capital capture.

samples.note: 5000-draw subsample; per-draw probabilities over 16 paths; year = per-draw median first-S4 year (NaN if none).

priors.T2: S2 midpoint year. Aligned to S2 model S2a onset (results/m2_no_customers_domino.json: p10 2038.75, median 2046, p90 2055.5): 2026 + LogNormal(median 20y, sigma 0.33).
priors.D_max: Plateau share of labor income lost, conditional on S2: U(0.3,0.8). S2 model median peak jobs lost given S2a 0.42.
priors.tau_D: Displacement ramp time scale U(2,6)y; judgment.
priors.lam: Loss aversion N(2.0,0.3) clipped [1.3,3]: Tversky & Kahneman 1992; Brown et al. 2024 meta-analysis.
priors.tau_ref: Reference-point adaptation U(2,6)y; Clark et al. 2008.
priors.mu_abs: Weight of absolute deprivation in grievance U(0.5,1.5); judgment.
priors.phi: Protest coalition cohesion U(0.4,0.9): UBI support 68% Dem vs 28% Rep (Gallup/Northeastern 2018).
priors.P_cap: Max participation share U(0.05,0.25): Chile 2019 ~6%, Hong Kong 2019 up to ~25%; Chenoweth 2020.
priors.g50: Grievance at half-max participation U(0.3,0.9); Granovetter 1978 thresholds; judgment.
priors.v_max: Eventual violent share U(0.3,0.7); scenario text; Soufan Center May 2026.
priors.s_loyal: Campaign success with loyal forces Beta mean 0.15: Iran 2026, Syria, Bahrain, HK, Belarus.
priors.s_def: Campaign success with defection U(0.6,0.9): Tunisia, Egypt, Bangladesh 2024, Nepal 2025, Madagascar 2025.
priors.viol_pen: Violence penalty on success U(0.4,0.6): violent 26% vs nonviolent 53% (Chenoweth & Stephan).
priors.k_auto: Curvature of defection removal (1-a)^k, U(1,3); judgment.
priors.t_half: Coercion automation a_t = sigmoid((t - t_half)/w). t_half = 2042.6 + N(0,4) + 0.5*(T2-2046) + regime shift: calendar-anchored so a(2035) median ~0.2 for leading states (prior 0.2, 0.05-0.5; Ukraine drones, Xinjiang), partially correlated with S2 timing.
priors.deter: Deterrence of participation by automated surveillance after repression U(0.3,0.8): Xinjiang (Greitens et al. 2019). Stock builds with repression, decays 20%/y.
priors.deter_pre: Pre-emptive surveillance/AI persuasion deterrence before any repression = deter * U(0.1,0.5); judgment.
priors.r0: AI/Big Tech share of state revenue today U(0.005,0.02): 10-K estimate.
priors.L0: Labor-linked revenue share: US 0.84 (CBO FY2025); other democracies 0.75; autocracies/China 0.6.
priors.LS: Labor share of GDP: US 0.55 (BLS), China 0.5, others 0.55. Converts transfers to GDP shares.
priors.cap_share: Share of displaced labor income captured as AI rents (S3) U(0.3,0.8).
priors.eff_tax: Effective tax on AI rents feeding ordinary revenue U(0.2,0.9).
priors.head: Extra taxable share of AI rents available to finance transfers U(0.2,0.6) (profit shifting, capital mobility); judgment.
priors.c_mass: Share of AI revenue ultimately dependent on mass consumer demand U(0.2,0.9): low = AI sells to state/military/firms (scenario text view); high = Fordist.
priors.kd: Mass demand loss per unit of uncompensated displacement U(0.3,0.9): savings, capital-income consumption buffers; S2 model finds consumption protected mainly by transfers.
priors.h_dom: Domestic share of AI rents for non-host states U(0.1,0.5).
priors.r_thr: Rentier threshold tri(0.25,0.4,0.6): petrostates vs Norway.
priors.m_rent: Rentier multiplier on accountability tri(0.5,0.67,1.0): Ross vs Haber & Menaldo.
priors.alpha1: Threshold increase in elite alignment with AI capital once rentier U(0.2,0.6); Drago & Laine 2025.
priors.lob: Continuous AI-capital lobbying/persuasion: alignment += lob*rr*(1-shield*I), lob U(0.2,1.0); judgment.
priors.A: Elite (AI capital) loss from net transfer tax, per 10% of GDP, U(0.3,1.5) times loss aversion and alignment; judgment (value of office per year = 1).
priors.Bf: Cost of transfer financing not covered by AI-rent tax (other taxes, deficit), per 10% of GDP, U(0.3,1.5); judgment.
priors.B: Electoral reward for restoring income U(1,3) times I; Acemoglu & Robinson; New Deal.
priors.Nd: 'People needed' value U(0.5,2) times dependence dep = 0.5*labor revenue share + 0.5*(1-a)^k (revenue and soldiers). Falls continuously with D and a; no threshold.
priors.C_rep: Repression cost U(0.2,1.0) per (P/0.035)^0.7 (concave), times (1-a)^k and (1-leg*v).
priors.K_inst: Institutional repression cost U(0.5,2) times I.
priors.V_off: Value of office lost on overthrow U(2,10).
priors.Sb: Sabotage cost to AI capital U(0,1) times v*min(P/0.035,3)*(1-a)^k; internalised by the state via alignment. 75 data-center projects blocked/delayed Q1 2026.
priors.g_x: Extra growth after automation log-U(0.005,0.2): abundance makes transfers cheaper relative to GDP.
priors.p_dr: P(democracy enacts a redistribution programme before mass unrest) tri(0.25,0.5,0.75). Calibrated per path so P(pre-empt before first mass unrest or horizon | mechanisms off) equals the target.
priors.p_perf: Autocracies' own P(pre-emptive transfer programme before mass unrest): China U(0.05,0.5) (1990s SOE layoffs of ~30M: xiagang allowances and dibao expansion from ~2.6M to ~22M recipients 1999-2002 show programmes do appear, but at low replacement rates, which cov captures; 'common prosperity' 2021 mostly rhetorical), generic autocracy U(0.05,0.5) (Gulf rentier welfare, small citizen populations). Independent of p_dr.
priors.cov: Coverage per concession round (share of the currently uncompensated labor-income loss replaced; rounds ratchet cumulatively, as welfare programmes expanded incrementally) 0.1 + 0.9*Beta(2.4,3.77), mean 0.45: China shock transfers offset ~10% of lost wages (Autor, Dorn & Hanson AER 2013) at the low end; CARES Act 2020 emergency UI (>100% replacement for many) at the high end.
priors.p_temp: P(transfer is temporary, emergency style) U(0.2,0.6); expires after U(2,5)y (CARES Act expired 2020-21). Permanence separate from coverage.
priors.p_index: P(permanent transfer is indexed to ongoing displacement) U(0.2,0.6).
priors.rho: Rollback hazard of transfers U(0.005,0.04)/y times alignment: Pierson 1994.
priors.beta_sq: Path dependence bonus for continuing repression U(0.2,1.0).
priors.pop0: Base utility of populist redirection U(-1.0,0.3), decays 0.3 per prior use: China shock political response was polarization, not transfers (Autor et al. AER 2020).
priors.pop_div: Participation diverted by populist redirection next year U(0.2,0.6), effectiveness 0.7^uses.
priors.cred: Credibility of transfers = 0.3+0.7*I: citizens discount non-credible transfers (Acemoglu-Robinson commitment problem); state's reward scales with it.
priors.eps_cap: Backsliding per unrest-year times alignment U(0,0.06); V-Dem 2026.
priors.p_dem_new: P(overthrow yields democracy): liberal/US U(0.5,0.9); others U(0.15,0.5). Overthrow into autocracy redraws SQ and m from the autocracy spec.
